sources.title: Emergency Response Support System — Government of India
sources.permission: Short factual paraphrase; underlying page copyright retained by government. No endorsement or open license claimed.
paragraphs: In India, 112 connects callers seeking urgent police, fire or health assistance to the emergency response system. Do not wait for a CARES directory or AI response in an emergency.

sources.title: National Health Mission — ERS / Patient Transport Service
sources.permission: Short factual paraphrase with attribution; no open license or redistribution of full source claimed.
paragraphs: Ambulance numbers 108 and 102 are operated through state or union territory arrangements. Their availability is regional. 108 focuses on emergency response; 102 supports patient transport, especially for women and children. Verify local arrangements.

sources.title: CARES — appointment request lifecycle
paragraphs: A CARES appointment starts as a request. The doctor may accept or decline it. A requested appointment is not a confirmed booking. Patients can view their own appointment status and cancel eligible requests in My Care. A published slot is a request option, not a live guarantee of availability.

sources.title: CARES — Care at Home enquiries
paragraphs: Care at Home accepts non-emergency nursing, physiotherapy and elder support enquiries. Patients submit contact, address, city and a preferred date. Administrators review enquiries and may contact the patient. No caregiver, price, visit or availability is promised. An enquiry is not a confirmed home-care booking.

sources.title: CARES — provider provenance
paragraphs: Synthetic demo providers are fictional examples and must be labeled. A publicly sourced listing is not necessarily CARES verified. Provider credentials require an administrative review before the CARES verification state is approved. Source links describe directory provenance, not current capacity or clinical quality.

sources.title: CARES — navigation and privacy limits
paragraphs: The Care Navigator provides service navigation only, not diagnosis or prescriptions. Do not enter names, contact details, patient records or medical history in AI questions. The navigation question and public retrieved passages are sent to the configured external language model. Private appointment queries require patient authentication and are displayed directly without sending appointment records to the model.
